label: DS-7 system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses the single-gene DefensePredictor-discovered system 7 locus cataloged with working_id SVIR and whose plasmid expression in E. coli MG1655 reduced bacteriophage plaquing.
observations: Phage-defense branch under phage defense system; distinct from the SVIR source working identifier, the individual DS-7 gene and protein, the DS-7 HMM profile row, Table S8 HHPred domain-annotation rows, cloned-transcriptional-unit plaquing assays, the absent DefenseFinder rule-level model, unresolved DS-7 HNH endonuclease activity and phage-baseplate-like hit, and other DefensePredictor-discovered or phage-defense systems.
